DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品の募集について、お問い合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the call for artworks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分で描いた絵を出してみたいです。でも展示が終わった後、返してもらえるかを先に知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人絵の展示後返却可否を応募前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to submit a picture I drew myself. But first I'd like to know whether I can have it back after the exhibition ends.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before applying, ask whether your own picture will be returned after the exhibition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 募集担当へ確認します。今、お手元の絵の大きさは分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check with the person in charge of submissions. Do you know the dimensions of the picture you have now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 縦三十センチ、横四十センチです。家族の作品ではなく、私が描いた一枚です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 縦三十横四十の本人作品一枚と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's thirty centimeters high and forty centimeters wide. It's one picture I drew myself, not a family member's work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is one work of your own, thirty centimeters high and forty wide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 返却と応募の条件は、この案内の担当へご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can ask the contact in this leaflet about return arrangements and submission conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は応募済みになったわけではないのですね。大きさが合うかと、返却を希望できるかを両方確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未応募と理解し寸法条件と返却希望を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So this doesn't mean I've already applied. I'll check both whether the dimensions meet the requirements and whether I can request its return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that you understand you have not applied yet, and check the size requirements and return request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 作品を手放す条件も、提出前にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before submitting it, please also check the conditions under which you would be giving up the work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家に飾るため描いた物なので、返らない募集なら今回は出さないつもりです。出せることだけで決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家で飾る絵なので返却不可なら出さない意向を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I drew it to display at home, so if the call doesn't allow works to be returned, I don't intend to submit it this time. I won't decide just because I'm eligible to submit it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to display the picture at home and will not submit it if it cannot be returned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付期間も案内にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The submission period is also in the leaflet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期間を見て、返却の条件を聞いてから応募を決めます。今日は担当の連絡先を持ち帰り、絵はまだ提出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 期間と返却を確認後決め今日は提出せず担当連絡先を持帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll look at the dates and ask about the return conditions before deciding to apply. Today I'll take the contact details home and won't submit the picture yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will decide after checking the dates and return conditions, and today will take the contact details home without submitting it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの案内をどうぞ。それでは、失礼いたします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 入院中のお食事について、お伝えになることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to tell us about your meals during your hospital stay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 宗教上、豚肉を食べません。食物アレルギーの症状の話とは別ですが、食事の担当へ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宗教上豚肉不可をアレルギー申告と区別して食事相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't eat pork for religious reasons. This is separate from reporting food allergy symptoms, but I'd like to discuss it with the person responsible for meals.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss your religious restriction on pork with the meal staff, distinguishing it from an allergy report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 食事の担当へご希望を伝えます。見た目に肉がない料理も気になるということでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll pass your wishes on to the meal staff. Are you also concerned about dishes that don't visibly contain meat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。汁や調味料に使われる場合もあるので、肉を皿から取れば済むとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 肉を除くだけでなく汁調味料の材料も気になると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It can also be used in soup or seasonings, so I don't think simply removing the meat from the plate would resolve it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are concerned about ingredients in soup and seasonings, not only removing meat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対応できる範囲は、担当が確認します。今ここで、ご希望の食事を必ず用意できるとは申し上げられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check what accommodations are possible. I can't promise here and now that we can provide the meals you want.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。病院からの説明を聞いて、どこまで対応できるかを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対応確約でないと理解し範囲の説明を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I understand. I'd like to hear the hospital's explanation and check how far you can accommodate this.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that accommodation is not guaranteed and ask for an explanation of what is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自分で外から食事を持ち込むご予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you planning to bring in food from outside yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今はありません。家族が料理を持ってくる案もありますが、入院の食事について確認する前に頼むのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外食持込未定で家族依頼を担当確認まで待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not at the moment. Having my family bring food is another idea, but I'll wait before asking them until we've checked the hospital meal arrangements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that bringing food is undecided and you will wait for confirmation before asking your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 食事の内容や持込みについて、担当の案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the staff's guidance about meal contents and bringing food in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。宗教上の希望と、入院中に食事をどう用意できるかを分けて相談します。勝手に食事の指示を変えず、確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宗教希望と入院食準備条件を分け担当の案内を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I'll discuss my religious wishes separately from how meals can be arranged during my stay. I'd like to check rather than change the meal instructions on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will follow staff guidance, distinguishing religious wishes from hospital meal arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 食事担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、少々お待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass this on to the meal staff. Please wait a moment. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらが、お探しの手袋でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the glove you're looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 最初は私の物だと思いましたが、よく見ると違います。受け取る前にお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 確認中手袋が別物と申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: At first I thought it was mine, but on closer inspection it isn't. I'd like to tell you before accepting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Tell the staff that the glove you are checking is not yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの部分が違いますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の手袋は内側に名前を縫っています。これは名前がなく、裏地の色も違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人名縫付と裏地の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: My glove has my name sewn inside. This one has no name, and the lining is a different color too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the sewn-in name and different lining. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見た目の色は似ていますが、お探しの物とは別ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The outside color looks similar, but this is not the one you're looking for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。外側が黒い点は同じですが、名前と裏地で別だと分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黒外側の一致だけでは本人品としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. They're both black outside, but I realized from the name and lining that this is a different one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not identify it as yours solely because the black exterior matches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、こちらはお預かりしたままにします。ご自身の物の特徴を補足しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then we'll keep holding this one. Let's add more identifying details for yours.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の裏地は灰色で、右手の内側に姓があります。最初の届けには外側の色だけ伝えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 灰裏地と右手内側姓を追加する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mine has a gray lining, and my surname is inside the right-hand glove. In my original report I only mentioned the outside color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Add the gray lining and surname inside the right-hand glove. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 補足した特徴を記録します。見つかったとはまだご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll record those additional details. We can't tell you yet that yours has been found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日はこの手袋を持ち帰らず、自分の物の連絡を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 別物を受取らず発見連絡を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't take this glove home today. I'll wait to hear about my own one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not accept the other glove and will wait for news of yours. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認にご協力いただきありがとうございました。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for helping us check. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お受け取りについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss receiving a delivery?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 不在が多いので、荷物を玄関前へ置いてほしいです。ここで頼めば、どの荷物もそうなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 玄関前配達希望と一律変更可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm often out, so I'd like parcels left outside my front door. If I ask here, will that apply to every parcel?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about delivery outside your door and whether all deliveries can be changed together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 荷物や配達条件によって異なります。すべて一律に変更するとはご案内できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: It depends on the parcel and delivery conditions. We can't say that every delivery can be changed in the same way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、今回の荷物について確認したいです。こちらが番号の書かれた案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回番号の荷物に相談を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I'd like to check about this particular parcel. Here's the notice with the number on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Limit your inquiry to the parcel with this number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号から担当へ確認します。玄関前とは、どの場所でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll use the number to check with the person responsible. Where exactly do you mean by outside your door?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 集合住宅の共用廊下です。ただ、ほかの人の通行を妨げるかもしれないので、そこに置けるかも相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 共用廊下の通行懸念も伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's a shared corridor in an apartment building. But it might obstruct other people, so I'd also like to ask whether it can be left there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention your concern about blocking the shared corridor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も含め担当へ確認します。今は、置いてよいとはまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll include that when checking with the person responsible. Permission to leave it there hasn't been decided yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。玄関前への変更が済んだとは考えず、確認の結果を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更未確定と理解し結果を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I won't assume the change to leaving it at my door has been made; I'll wait for the result.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that the change is unconfirmed and wait for the result. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望に添えない場合、別の受取方法も担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If your request can't be accommodated, please discuss another way of receiving it with the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その場合は受け取れる時間を相談します。今回は番号のある一件として、希望を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不可時は時間相談を希望し今回一件の伝達を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: In that case I'll discuss a time when I can receive it. Please pass on my request for this one numbered delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to discuss a receiving time if necessary and have your request passed on for this delivery only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、失礼いたします。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 預金のご相談で、先にお確かめになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you'd like to check first about your deposit inquiry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 預金について相談したいですが、ここで大きな金額を声に出すのは気になります。別の伝え方はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 金額を公に口頭で言わない伝達方法を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to discuss my savings, but I feel uncomfortable saying a large amount out loud here. Is there another way to communicate it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a way to communicate the amount without saying it aloud publicly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 金額をこちらの紙へお書きいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can write the amount on this paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙でお願いします。相談したい金額を書きますが、今すぐ引き出す申込みではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙に金額を記し即時引出申請でないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd prefer paper. I'll write the amount I want to discuss, but this isn't an application to withdraw it right now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Write the amount on paper and explain that you are not requesting an immediate withdrawal. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご相談の内容も、一緒にお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write what you'd like to discuss as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一部を定期にするか考えている、と書きました。商品を決めているわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一部定期の相談で商品未決定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written that I'm considering putting part of it in a fixed-term deposit. I haven't decided on a product.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you are considering a fixed-term deposit for part of the money and have not selected a product. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当との相談席へご案内します。お書きになった紙も一緒にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll show you to a consultation desk. Please take the paper you wrote on with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相談席へ持っていきます。利息だけでなく、必要な時に使えるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相談席で利息と使える条件を尋ねたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll bring it to the desk. I'd like to ask not only about interest but also whether I can use the money when I need it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to ask about interest and access conditions at the consultation desk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのご希望を担当へお伝えください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。金額は紙で示し、使う可能性があることを話します。説明を聞いてから判断します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙金額と使用可能性を示し説明後判断すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll show the amount on paper and explain that I may need to use it. I'll decide after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will show the amount on paper, explain the possible need to use it, and decide after the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当がお待ちです。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The adviser is waiting for you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お惣菜のご予約ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to reserve some prepared food?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族四人分を頼みたいですが、夫も電話したと言っています。二重になっていないか先に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族予約の重複有無を先に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to order for a family of four, but my husband says he called too. Could you check first that we haven't ordered twice?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: First ask whether your family's reservation has been duplicated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 照会するご予約のお名前を教えてください。ご家族は、いつお電話になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me the name on the reservation you'd like checked. When did your family member call?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエンです。夫は今日の午前中に四人分と伝えたそうです。追加の注文ではなく、その予約を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: グエンの予約名と夫の午前四人注文を伝え既存予約の照会だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nguyen. My husband says he asked for four portions this morning. I want to check that reservation, not place an additional order.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the reservation name Nguyen and your husband's morning order for four, explaining that you are checking an existing reservation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: グエン様のお名前で、四人分一件の記録があります。受取日は明日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We have one reservation for four portions under Nguyen. The pickup date is tomorrow.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日で合っています。その予約を使いますので、追加はしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 明日一件の一致と追加不要を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tomorrow is correct. We'll use that reservation, so please don't add anything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm tomorrow's single reservation and say no additional order is needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今ある一件をそのままにして、追加はなさらないということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: So you'd like to leave the existing reservation as it is, without adding another?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。その一件を家族で食べます。受け取るのは夫ではなく、私になりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 既存一件利用と本人受取予定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Our family will eat that one order. I'll probably pick it up myself rather than my husband.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use the existing order and probably collect it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受け取りの時に、ご予約名をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please give the reservation name when collecting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予約名を伝えます。夫にも四人分一件だけと連絡し、別に注文しないよう話しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約名提示と夫への重複防止連絡を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I'll also tell my husband that we have only one order for four and ask him not to order separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will give the reservation name and contact your husband to prevent a duplicate order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、現在のご予約を変更せずお待ちします。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll leave your existing reservation unchanged and look forward to seeing you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その木について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about that tree?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが、実が図鑑の食べられる物に似ていると言っています。まだ取っていませんが、ここで食べられると考えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図鑑に似た実を食用と判断してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child says its fruit looks like something edible in a field guide. We haven't picked any, but can we assume it's safe to eat here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether fruit resembling a picture in a field guide can be judged edible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真に似ているだけで、食べられるとは判断できません。園内の実を取って食べないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can't determine that it's edible just because it resembles a photo. Please don't pick and eat fruit in the park.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもも食べていません。私が先に味を見て確かめることもしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 親子未採食で試食判定も行わないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I understand. My child hasn't eaten any either. I won't taste it first myself to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that neither you nor your child has picked or eaten it and you will not test it by tasting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 木の種類を知りたい場合は、管理の担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you'd like to know the species, you can ask the park management staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 種類は知りたいです。食べるために枝ごと持って帰るのではなく、この場所で名前を尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 枝を持帰らず現地で樹名を知りたいと希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to know the species. Rather than take a branch home to eat the fruit, I'd like to ask its name here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to learn the tree's name on site without taking a branch home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この木の場所を担当へ伝えます。幹や葉も、離れた場所からご覧になれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the staff where this tree is. You can also look at the trunk and leaves from a distance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 葉と木全体の写真を撮ります。実の近い写真だけで同じ種類だと決めず、担当に見てもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 葉全体写真を撮り実の接写だけで同種判断しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take photos of the leaves and the whole tree. I won't decide it's the same species from a close-up of the fruit alone; I'll have the staff look at it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Take photos of the leaves and whole tree, without identifying the species from a fruit close-up alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 名前を確認できても、食べてよいというご案内とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if we identify its name, that's separate from telling you it's all right to eat it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。子どもには、木の名前を知ることと実を食べることは別だと伝えます。今日は観察だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 樹名判明と食用可否を区別し今日は観察のみと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll tell my child that learning the tree's name and eating its fruit are different things. We'll just observe it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish knowing the tree's name from permission to eat its fruit, and say today is for observation only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23233-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ観察をお楽しみください。それでは、失礼します。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの動物について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss the animal you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 西春駅で猫を入れたかばんを持っています。鳴いているので外へ出したくなりましたが、駅で開ける前に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 猫鳴きで駅で開放前に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm at Nishiharu Station carrying a bag with a cat inside. It's meowing and I felt like letting it out, but I'd like to ask before opening it in the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice before letting your meowing cat out in the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 逃げ出すことがないよう、かばんを閉めたままお持ちください。列車での取扱いも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please keep the bag closed so it can't escape. Let's also check the arrangements for taking it on the train.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。閉めたまま持っています。鳴いているのですが、このまま相談して大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 閉じたまま保持し鳴く状態で相談してよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. I'm keeping it closed. It's meowing; is it all right to discuss this as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Keep the bag closed and ask whether you may consult staff while the cat is meowing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで確認しましょう。まず、かばんの状態を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check here. First, could you show me the condition of the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。持ち手はしっかりしています。今は私が持っていますが、確認中はどこに置けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持ち手の状態を示し確認時の置き場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. The handles are secure. I'm holding it now, but where should I put it while you check?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that the handles are secure and ask where to put the bag during the check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの台へ静かに置いてください。持込みの条件は、担当がかばんを確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please set it gently on this stand. The person in charge will inspect the bag and explain the conditions for bringing it aboard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 台へ置きました。猫が落ち着くまで少し待って、利用できるか確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定台に静かに置き乗車条件の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've set it on the stand. Please let the cat settle a little, then check whether I can travel with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Place it gently on the designated stand and ask staff to check the conditions for boarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご乗車前に、必要な確認を進めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's complete the necessary checks before you board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 猫を入れたまま、このかばんで利用できるか確認します。もし条件に合わなければ、別の移動方法を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 閉かばん利用可否を聞き不可なら別移動検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check whether I can travel with the cat still inside this bag. If it doesn't meet the conditions, I'll consider another way to travel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask whether the closed bag is permitted and consider other transport if it is not. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当を呼んできます。かばんを閉じたまま、こちらでお待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll get the person in charge. Please wait here with the bag closed. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の催しについて、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss a community event?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人と手作りの菓子を売ってみたいです。家で作れることだけで出店できると思わず、先に相談先を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家庭菓子販売可と思込まず相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend and I would like to sell homemade sweets. Rather than assume that being able to make them at home means we can have a stall, I'd first like to know whom to ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whom to consult instead of assuming you can sell homemade sweets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出店の申込みと、食品の取扱いについて、それぞれ確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You need to check separately about applying for a stall and handling food.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 出店の申込みは主催者、食品については別の窓口なのですね。両方へ相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 主催者と食品相談窓口の両方へ確認する必要を理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the event organizer handles stall applications, and a different office advises on food. I'd like to consult both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand you must check with both the organizer and the food advice office. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 作る物や予定を、相談先へ具体的にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell the people you consult specifically what you plan to make and your arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 焼き菓子を考えていますが、作る場所と数はまだ決めていません。決まったことと未定のことを分けて話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 焼菓子案と製造場所数量未定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: We're thinking of baked sweets, but haven't decided where to make them or how many. I'll distinguish what is decided from what is still undecided.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain your baked-sweets idea and that the preparation location and quantity are undecided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 食品については、関係する相談窓口をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: For food matters, I'll direct you to the relevant advice office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相談先をお願いします。必要な準備を聞いてから、友人と今回の出店に間に合うか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件を聞いて友人と今回の準備が間に合うか検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please give me the contact. Once we've asked what preparations are required, my friend and I will consider whether we can be ready for this event.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about requirements and discuss with your friend whether you can prepare in time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 申込みの締切も、主催者にご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the application deadline with the organizer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 締切は主催者に聞きます。食品の条件も確認して、二人で計画を決めてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 締切と食品条件を確認して二人で計画後に申込む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the organizer about the deadline. We'll also check the food requirements, decide on our plan together, and then apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the deadline and food requirements, then plan together before applying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが相談先の案内です。それでは、よくご確認のうえお進めください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the contact information. Please check the details carefully before proceeding. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 胸の音を聞きますので、準備をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: We'll explain how to prepare so the doctor can listen to your chest.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 首に長いストールを巻いています。どこまで外せばよいか、自分で全部脱ぐ前に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 首ストールと衣服を全部脱ぐ前に範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm wearing a long stole around my neck. Before I take everything off myself, please tell me how much I need to remove.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how much clothing and your neck stole to remove before taking everything off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まずストールを外して、こちらへ置いてください。その後の衣服は順にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: First remove the stole and put it here. We'll explain the rest of the clothing step by step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ストールだけを先に外します。椅子から床へ垂れないよう、畳んで置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指定ストールのみ外し床に垂らさず畳むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll remove only the stole first. I'll fold it before putting it down so it doesn't hang from the chair onto the floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will remove only the indicated stole and fold it so it does not trail on the floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご不安なことがありましたら、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us if anything worries you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人が入って来ないか気になります。衣服を動かす前に、カーテンが閉まっているか確かめてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 衣服移動前にカーテン閉確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm concerned that someone might come in. Before I move my clothing, could you check that the curtain is closed?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask staff to check that the curtain is closed before you move your clothing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 閉まっていることを確認しました。必要な範囲をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've checked that it's closed. I'll explain how much needs to be moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。服はどの辺りまで動かせばいいですか。指で示してもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 衣服を動かす範囲を指で示してほしいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. How far should I move my clothes? It would help if you could point to the area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask staff to point out the area of clothing to move. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの胸の部分を、先生の案内に合わせて少し動かしてください。終わったらお声がけします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please move this chest area slightly, following the doctor's instructions. We'll let you know when it's finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 終わったと声をかけられてから戻します。ストールも最後に受け取り、置き忘れないよう確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了合図後復衣しストール忘れを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put it back after you tell me it's finished. I'll also collect my stole at the end and check that I haven't left it behind.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will put your clothes back after the completion signal and check you have not forgotten your stole. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ストールはこちらでお預かりします。先生を呼んできますので、お待ちください。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23234-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll keep your stole here. I'll get the doctor, so please wait. Goodbye.
